mobile._comment: Device matrix example for vision-loop — copy into your vision-loop.config.json. Plain JSON: every hint rides a _comment field (ignored by the parser); delete them in your copy. Every case runs once PER DEVICE (fan-out); artifacts, judgments and diffs land under the identity <label>__<deviceKey>__<key>.

devices.label: iPhone 16
devices._comment: EXAMPLE PLACEHOLDER — put YOUR simulator UDID here. Find it with: xcrun simctl list devices | grep 'iPhone 16' (the value looks like 3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301; 'booted' also works when exactly one simulator is booted).

devices.label: Pixel 6
devices._comment: emulator-5554 is the first booted AVD's default serial — list yours with `adb devices` and replace if it differs (a physical Pixel 6 over USB reports its own serial instead).

cases.label: home
cases._comment: No launch hooks here: captures whatever app/screen is foreground after settleMs. Add openUrl (deep link) for iOS, or launchActivity/openUrl for Android, to navigate first. devices omitted -> runs on BOTH devices -> reference/current/diff + metadata under home__iphone16__home and home__pixel6__home.

cases.label: chat
cases._comment: Optional per-case devices subset: "devices": ["iphone16"] would restrict this case to one device; absent (or null) means every declared device. IMPORTANT: with a device matrix, per-case udid/serial are rejected by config validation — endpoints belong on the device rows above.
